feeds.title: Travel Fashion Girl
feeds.description: Travel Fashion Girl is your go-to source for travel fashion for women, from packing lists to the best clothes for travel. Find out how to pack light and stylishly for your next trip.

feeds.title: The Blonde Abroad Blog
feeds.description: The Blonde Abroad is an award-winning solo female travel blog featuring travel tips, packing guides, videos, and photography from around the world.

feeds.title: Anna Everywhere
feeds.description: I'm Anna and I'm a world traveler. So far I visited over 77 countries and lived on 5 continents discovering their cultures, history and learning languages. I want to show you the different aspects of travel experiences and how can you travel with purpose and learn from it.

feeds.title: Dreams in Heels
feeds.description: Dreams in Heels is an award-winning solo female travel blog featuring travel tips, style, luxury travel & lifestyle to inspire women to follow their dreams. Join Latina Influencer Olga Maria of Dreamsinheels.com on her journeys to different destinations while together we explore the cuisine, the lifestyle, the culture and we interact with locals.

feeds.title: The Style Traveller
feeds.description: The Style Traveller, A fashion editor's guide to the world's most stylish places, founded by Bonnie Rakhit, fashion, shopping, cool bars, boutique hotels.

feeds.title: Travel Beauty Blog
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog that shares fashion, beauty, lifestyle and travel tips for women

feeds.title: Foreign Fresh & Fierce
feeds.description: Foreign Fresh & Fierce is a Dallas Fashion, Beauty & Travel Blog in which you will find all the latest trends, styling tips, beauty tips, travel reviews and much more.

feeds.title: Road Dress Travelled
feeds.description: The Road Dress Travelled by Prarthana Purushothaman is a perfect blog to inspire travel, fashion enthusiasts and beauty lovers all over the globe!

feeds.title: Traveling Chic
feeds.description: Traveling Chic began in 2007 as your passport to stylish travel around the world. A source for inspiration that covers everything from where to visit, what to pack, and how to travel in style. These pages are filled with everything I love about travel: food, fashion, culture, and the little joys that come from new adventures!

feeds.title: Laureen Uy
feeds.description: Laureen Uy is a fashion and travel blogger from the Philippines. She co-founded Stylebreak, a clothing line that features garments that she embellished herself. Sharing with you a collection of my travels, fashion trends, and everything in between.

feeds.title: StyleHopping
feeds.description: I am Angelica Guillen, a Latina model, blogger, and actress. I was born and raised in the Dominican Republic. I enjoy writing about fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and travel. Welcome to my blog!

feeds.title: The Belle Voyage
feeds.description: Wanderlust meets style at The Belle Voyage, a lifestyle diary dedicated to women who travel. From how to look fresh-faced after a red-eye flight, to putting together carry on-ready capsule wardrobes, The Belle Voyage inspires female travelers to make their travel effortless and beautiful and shows us that living a life well-traveled doesn't have to mean sacrificing style. Subscribe to get Travel itineraries, Travel Tips and Travel Fashion for Female Travel.

feeds.title: The Clumsy Traveler
feeds.description: The Clumsy Traveler is a travel and lifestyle blog following the inspirational and entertaining travels of Sebrin Elms. Follow along for travel tips, fashion, beauty and photography from around the world.
